Steel Pipe & Tube Wholesaler in Kanpur
We are a Kanpur-based wholesale distributor of ERW pipes, seamless and boiler tubes, precision hydraulic tubes, borewell casing, fittings, flanges, valves, and related steel tubular products for B2B procurement. Our indicative prices use an ex-warehouse Kanpur basis, with freight and taxes shown separately. The current quotation should name the HSN and apply GST at the rate legally applicable to the invoiced item and invoice date.
Compare standards and sizes on the product pages, then send us the required grade, dimensions, quantity, delivery location, and documentation needs through the RFQ form. Availability, inspection, certification, freight, and delivery timing are confirmed for the specific requirement before order finalisation.

Ajay Jaiswal

About RP Sales
Procurement support built around technical requirements
We operate from Kanpur's steel market and supply industrial pipe and tube requirements across product families used in construction, water systems, boilers, process lines, fabrication, hydraulics, drilling and printing applications.
Send us the dimensions, material standard, quantity, delivery location, and documentation needs for your enquiry. That is what our RFQ flow asks for, because those details decide whether the item suits the job.
About RP Sales
WhatsApp us
Kanpur buying desk
Buying steel pipe in Kanpur starts with the service requirement
Send the trade name with the dimensions and documents. Water pipe, boiler tube, hydraulic tube, borewell casing, and printing-cylinder blank each need their own dimensions, documents and acceptance checks. The drawing, BOQ, tender schedule, or approved material list should control the requirement.
PWD and JJM tender bidders should send us the complete BOQ line and any source-approval or inspection conditions. Sugar mills and boiler fabricators should identify the grade, size, wall, IBR requirement, shutdown sequence, and component-specific form need before asking for a rate. Hydraulic and printing-cylinder shops should lead with OD, ID, wall, tolerance, surface condition, machining allowance, and cut length.
Local fabricators in Panki, Dada Nagar, Jajmau, Chakeri, and Fazalganj often buy mixed requirements. Keep every item on its own RFQ line with the correct standard and unit, so an ERW fabrication tube, a seamless process pipe, and a precision component tube are not compared as though all three were the same product.

How Kanpur buyers compare a complete steel pipe offer
Compare technical compliance before comparing the per-kilogram rate. Check the process, standard, grade, NB or OD, wall or schedule, length, end finish, and coating. Then check the quantity basis, mill source, MTC, inspection, packing, freight, and the requested delivery window.
Your quotation should separate the ex-warehouse Kanpur material value, freight to the named destination, and taxes. Confirm the HSN and tax treatment on the current quotation; GST or other taxes should use the rate legally applicable to the invoiced item and invoice date. A delivered figure is comparable only when every bidder has priced the same consignee, handling scope, and product specification. Use our
pricing guide
 and the matching
MS pipe price list
 only for budgeting, then request a firm offer for your actual BOQ.
Put documentation in the PO, not in a message sent after loading. State the MTC type, heat traceability, the applicable IBR form, TPI, dimensional reports, coating records, and inspection hold points where your job requires them. Ask bidders to list deviations in writing, especially when a proposed source, grade, wall, or delivery condition differs.
Dispatch from Kanpur to UP and North India project sites
We dispatch daily from Kanpur across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Delhi NCR, and Uttarakhand. You may request delivered freight or arrange collection from our Kanpur yard on an ex-works basis. The RFQ should state which basis applies before commercial comparison.
Give us the exact destination and receiving contact for Kanpur Dehat, Unnao, Lucknow, Agra, Prayagraj, Varanasi, Gorakhpur, Jhansi, Bareilly, Patna, or another project city. Long material, protected threads, coated pipe, and finished precision bores may need different loading and securing. Add unloading limits and site access details rather than relying on the city name alone.
Link the packing list to each product line, heat or batch reference, and certificate. Your receiving team should compare bundle count, markings, visible condition, and documents before material is cut or issued. For city-specific procurement, review
Kanpur steel pipe supply
,
Lucknow delivery
,

What to include in a first enquiry
Describe each item in full: the standard and grade, the size and wall thickness, the length, how the ends are finished, the coating or surface finish, and the quantity. Put each item on its own line.
If you need a mill test certificate, an IBR form, third-party inspection, or particular marking, packing or inspection requirements, say so before the purchase order rather than after the material is loaded.
Tell us whether you want the price ex-works from our Kanpur yard or delivered to site. For a delivered price, give the destination PIN code and any limits on unloading there.
Compare offers on the complete scope, technical and landed, before you negotiate the unit rate. Two rates are only comparable when they cover the same material, documents and delivery.

Better RFQs, fewer assumptions
What to include when requesting a pipe quote
A useful RFQ makes the engineering and commercial requirement explicit. Put the complete technical, documentation, and delivery requirement into the RFQ so alternatives are not treated as equivalents and freight or documentation is not added as an afterthought.
If the standard or grade is unclear, share the drawing, BOQ, previous MTC, or application details, and ask our sales team what information is still needed before quoting.

Common questions
Frequently asked questions
How is the pricing of steel pipes calculated?
A current quotation can use a per-kg, per-meter, or per-piece basis. Ask it to name the specification, dimensions, proposed source, quantity, weight basis, documentation, tax treatment, freight basis, and validity that apply to that enquiry.
Do you offer bulk discounts for large orders?
Quantity pricing depends on the enquiry. Ask the current quotation to state any applicable quantity break, minimum, mixed-load condition, and vehicle basis. A truck-planning range or an earlier website band is not an automatic discount.
What is the difference between theoretical and actual weight pricing?
Theoretical weight comes from stated dimensions and a standard formula. Actual weight is measured for the material or load. The current quotation and order should state which basis controls billing, and how coating, tolerances, and weighbridge records are handled.
How long is a quotation valid?
Use only the expiry date or acceptance condition printed on the current quotation. A change in product, quantity, source, documents, destination, tax treatment, freight, or payment basis may require a written revision.
Are there hidden charges like loading or packing?
No. The current quotation separates material value, freight, and any other charges. It should also identify the HSN and tax treatment, with GST or other taxes applied at the rate legally applicable to the invoiced item and invoice date.
Which geographical areas do you serve?
Send the destination city and PIN code with the current RFQ. Treat a city or region name as an enquiry location, not proof of coverage. Any offered supply and transport basis should be stated in the current written quotation, after the product, quantity, vehicle, route, site access, and receiving constraints are reviewed.
